subject: MSA + Order Form redlines — subscription cadence & sunset trigger
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novitas.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novitas.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Redline: MSA + Order Form — subscription cadence & sunset trigger

Hi Naomi / Laura,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached are Novitas' clean redlines to the MSA (v3) and the Order Form. Two items we want to surface immediately so legal and commercial are aligned:

1) Subscription cadence: Our procurement policy requires a 12-month minimum firm term with quarterly billing by default. You proposed annual auto-renew — we redlined to require explicit opt-in for auto-renew or an affirmative renewal notice 60 days before term end.

2) Sunset / offboarding trigger: We added language requiring a 90-day transition assistance period for offboards that affect live patient workflows, with an associated cap on fees. We also added an explicit data export runbook and a 30-day notice for data retrieval before archival.

Can your legal/commercial teams confirm whether Redwood can:
- Accept a firm 12-month minimum but keep auto-renew with a 60-day notice window?
- Agree to a 90-day transition assistance for regulated workloads but with a limited liability cap tied to unused committed spend?

We've attached an editable redline (MSA_v3_redline.pdf) and a schedule for billing cadence changes (OrderForm_ScheduleA.xlsx). Alex is on copy from procurement — he can run the internal sign-off if commercial terms land.

Goal: get to a mutually acceptable redline by end of week so we can move to procurement approval.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Procurement, Novitas Health
ellen.park@novitas.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MSA_v3_redline.pdf (redline), OrderForm_ScheduleA.xlsx (billing schedule)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novitas.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redline: MSA + Order Form — subscription cadence & sunset trigger

Ellen — thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. Quick thoughts from our side after a rapid legal/commercial sync: 

- Firm term / auto-renew: We're comfortable with a 12-month initial commitment. For auto-renew, our standard is automatic renewal for successive 12-month terms unless customer provides notice 30 days prior. We can accept 60 days in this case, but would need to preserve the ability to invoice for the upcoming renewal period on Day 1 of the new term (so internal billing systems align).

- Sunset / transition assistance: We can commit to a 90-day transition assistance window for regulated workloads, with a fixed professional-services rate for assistance beyond standard handover (we will describe the scope in Schedule X). Regarding liability cap tied to unused committed spend — we prefer a mutual, fixed cap (e.g., lesser of 6 months' fees or committed spend). Can Novitas confirm whether that structure would be acceptable?

Next steps I propose:
- Laura / Marcus to mark up MSA_v3_redline.pdf for the two clauses (auto-renew notice window + transition assistance liability cap) and return a short summary of proposed redline language by EOD tomorrow.
- If Novitas can live with the mutual fixed-cap suggestion, we push the doc to Alex for procurement review the same day.

Two quick asks for your procurement team:
1) Can you confirm whether billing must be quarterly in the Order Form or if annual invoicing is acceptable provided quarterly usage reports are supplied?
2) Are there any internal approval deadlines we should know about (procurement committee dates)?

I'll drop our marked PDF and a short summary into the SharePoint link and ping you when done.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com
(650) 555-0147

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novitas.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redline: MSA + Order Form — subscription cadence & sunset trigger

Ellen / Naomi / team — looping back with the redline language and a short commercial position. Apologies for the slightly longer note, wanted to be specific so procurement can move quickly.

Proposed language (high level):
- Auto-renew / notice: "Unless Customer provides written notice of non-renewal to Redwood at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current Term, the Term shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods. Redwood will invoice for the renewed Term on the first day of such renewed Term unless otherwise agreed in writing."

- Transition assistance / sunset: "In the event of expiration or termination, Redwood will provide up to ninety (90) days of transition assistance to enable orderly data export and service wind-down for regulated workloads. Redwood may charge professional services rates for assistance beyond standard offboarding as set forth in Schedule X. Customer shall have thirty (30) days from the date of final data export to retrieve Customer Data prior to archival."

- Liability cap (commercial compromise): "The liability cap applicable to transition assistance shall be the lesser of (a) six (6) months of fees paid under the Order Form, or (b) the unconsumed portion of any pre-paid committed spend."

Commercial notes:
- Billing cadence: Redwood can support quarterly invoicing on the Order Form. If Novitas prefers quarterly billing, we'll reflect it in Schedule A; the system will still operate on 12-month terms for consumption/commit.
- Approval timeline: Naomi — Novitas' note referenced end-of-week for sign-off. If procurement needs committee approval, ask Alex to flag the committee date; we can prioritize a short executive summary for the committee packet.

I uploaded the marked PDF to our legal SharePoint and attached a clean redline as requested. Ellen / Alex, please confirm whether the liability cap formula is acceptable or if Novitas requires a pure-unused-spend cap (we can do that but it increases Redwood's downside).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-30m call if that helps close.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
VP, Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
